description: This file defines a utility enum 'OpenClawConfigFile' in Swift that manages reading, writing, and monitoring configuration files for the OpenClaw application. It includes functions for loading and saving dictionaries, handling gateway configurations, controlling browser settings, managing agent workspaces, and conducting file integrity checks and audits. The code interacts with the file system, performs JSON serialization/deserialization, and logs audit and suspicious activity related to configuration management.

methods.name: url
methods.description: Returns the URL of the main configuration file.

methods.name: stateDirURL
methods.description: Returns the URL for the state directory used for logs and health files.

methods.name: defaultWorkspaceURL
methods.description: Provides the default workspace URL.

methods.name: loadDict
methods.description: Loads and parses the configuration dictionary from the config file. Returns an empty dictionary if the file does not exist or fails to parse.

methods.name: saveDict
methods.description: Serializes and saves a configuration dictionary to disk, with audit logging and suspicious activity detection.

methods.name: loadGatewayDict
methods.description: Retrieves the 'gateway' sub-dictionary from the main config.

methods.name: updateGatewayDict
methods.description: Updates the 'gateway' section of the configuration by applying a mutation, then saves.

methods.name: browserControlEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether the browser control feature is enabled, with a default value.

methods.name: setBrowserControlEnabled
methods.description: Sets the browser control enabled state.

methods.name: agentWorkspace
methods.description: Retrieves the configured agent workspace string.

methods.name: setAgentWorkspace
methods.description: Sets the agent workspace string in the configuration.

methods.name: gatewayPassword
methods.description: Retrieves the remote gateway password from the configuration.

methods.name: gatewayPort
methods.description: Retrieves the port number for the gateway, parsing from string or number.

methods.name: remoteGatewayPort
methods.description: Gets the port of the remote gateway URL if present.

methods.name: remoteGatewayPort(matchingHost:)
methods.description: Gets the remote gateway port matching a specific SSH host, verifying host key.

methods.name: setRemoteGatewayUrl
methods.description: Sets the remote gateway URL, given a host and port.

methods.name: clearRemoteGatewayUrl
methods.description: Removes the remote gateway URL from the configuration.

methods.name: hostKey
methods.description: Generates a normalized host key string for comparison, considering IPv4 addresses and hostnames.

methods.name: parseConfigData
methods.description: Parses raw JSON data into a dictionary, handling JSON5 if supported.

methods.name: stampMeta
methods.description: Adds metadata with app version and timestamp to the config root.

methods.name: hasMeta
methods.description: Checks if the config root has a 'meta' section.

methods.name: gatewayMode
methods.description: Extracts the 'mode' string from the 'gateway' section.

methods.name: configWriteSuspiciousReasons
methods.description: Analyzes reasons for suspicious config write activity, such as size drops or missing meta.

methods.name: configAuditLogURL
methods.description: Returns URL for the config audit log.

methods.name: configHealthStateURL
methods.description: Returns URL for the config health state log.

methods.name: readConfigHealthState
methods.description: Reads and returns the current config health state dictionary.

methods.name: writeConfigHealthState
methods.description: Saves the config health state dictionary to disk.

methods.name: configHealthEntry
methods.description: Retrieves a specific health audit entry for a config path.

methods.name: setConfigHealthEntry
methods.description: Sets a health audit entry for a config path.

methods.name: isUpdateChannelOnlyRoot
methods.description: Checks if the root dictionary contains only an update channel.

methods.name: fileTimestampMs
methods.description: Converts file modification or creation date to milliseconds timestamp.

methods.name: fileAttributeInt
methods.description: Converts file attribute value to Int.

methods.name: fileSystemNumber
methods.description: Returns string representation of a file system number attribute.

methods.name: posixMode
methods.description: Extracts POSIX permissions bits from file attribute.

methods.name: configFingerprint
methods.description: Creates a fingerprint dictionary for the config file, including hash and metadata.

methods.name: sameFingerprint
methods.description: Checks if two fingerprints are identical.

methods.name: observeSuspiciousReasons
methods.description: Determines reasons why a config's fingerprint may be suspicious (size change, missing meta).

methods.name: readConfigFingerprint
methods.description: Reads the current fingerprint of a config file.

methods.name: configTimestampToken
methods.description: Replace colons and dots in timestamp string with hyphens for filename safety.

methods.name: persistClobberedSnapshot
methods.description: Stores a backup copy of a clobbered config snapshot.

methods.name: observeConfigRead
methods.description: Handles the logic after reading a config file, including fingerprints, suspicious checks, and audit logging.

methods.name: appendConfigWriteAudit
methods.description: Appends an audit record for a config write activity.

methods.name: appendConfigObserveAudit
methods.description: Appends an audit record for a config read/observation activity.
